messages:
Amira Khan: Crescent Labs (mid-market biotech) just asked for a 90m enablement clinic focused on staged model rollouts and rollback drills. They want a hands-on lab + renewal check-in. Can we fit them next Thurs afternoon UTC?
Jonas Reed: I can cover rollout strategies (canary, weighted traffic, stage pinning). Prefer 14:30-16:00 UTC to hit EMEA/APAC overlap.
Ravi Iyer: 14:30 works for me for the lab portion. We'll need a sanitized config snapshot + test dataset. Also suggest pairing the session with a short renewal health check at the end.
Maya Chen: I'll handle invites, recording, and capture the feedback survey. Proposed agenda: 10m intros, 25m rollout patterns, 30m guided lab (runbook), 15m rollback drill + 10m feedback/renewal pulse.
Amira Khan: Please add an item to surface "top migration blockers" for our renewals team. Use the capture form to flag any blockers as high/medium/low risk.
Jonas Reed: For the lab script I'll prepare a compact runner: `scripts/rollout-demo.sh` and a step-by-step playbook. Will post by Mon EOD.
Cal (calendar-bot): Provisional event created: Crescent Labs Rollout Clinic  provisional on CS calendar. Link: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/crescent-rollout.
Maya Chen: Prework checklist: 1) attendee list 2) sanitized config + creds (read-only) 3) confirm PKS/Infra env 4) short pre-survey (1 q). I'll send the pre-survey after we confirm time.
Ravi Iyer: For the rollback drill we'll demo KV cache prune and model variant fallback. I'll prepare a bullet list of commands and safe checkpoints.
Amira Khan: Feedback capture link for renewal signal: https://forms.gle/redwood-crescent-feedback  questions include "post-session confidence (1-5)", "top outstanding risk", "interest in Dedicated migration help".
Cal (calendar-bot): Poll posted: `poll: ["14:30-16:00 UTC", "15:00-16:30 UTC"]` Closes in 2h. Recording preset = on.
Jonas Reed: If majority picks 14:30 I'm good. Also request a test tenant snapshot from Crescent by Tue so demo can use realistic data.
Maya Chen: Poll closed  selected `14:30-16:00 UTC`. Event confirmed and invites sent. Shared folder: https://drive.redwood.example/crescent-rollout (agenda + prework + runbook). Recording enabled, new channel created: #crescent-rollout-clinic.
Amira Khan: Great. I'll join for the renewal recap and note any upsell signals. Moving follow-ups into the new channel. Closing this scheduling thread.
